text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Japanese Derby, Zenno 
Rob Roy begged Symboli Kris S, whom she 
deeply respected, to watch her race.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The next day. A roar of cheers echoes 
around her. But she will no longer be 
overwhelmed. Resolving to become an 
"unwavering hero," she presses forward on 
her unbending path.
